o.text: From Ottoman Turkish سیغورته (sığorta/sığurta), from Italian sicurtà (“insurance”), from Latin securitas (“safety”), from securus.
Borrowed from Russian борт (bort), from Dutch boord.
From Russian команди́р (komandír), from French commandeur.
Borrowed from Arabic شَهْلَاء (šahlāʔ), feminine singular of أَشْهَل (ʔašhal).
Borrowed from Russian каземат (kazemat), ultimately from Italian casamatta.
From Persian دالاندار. By surface analysis, dalan + -dar.
From Persian بدخرج By surface analysis, bəd- + xərc.
From Russian монасты́рь (monastýrʹ), ultimately from Ancient Greek μοναστήριον (monastḗrion).
